entities.title: Each dependency for one reason
entities.summary: zazzled depends on a short list of crates, each for one stated reason; std covers everything else.
entities.context: zazzled is a long-lived daemon that agents call constantly; every dependency is code to build, audit and keep current.
entities.decision: Dependencies, each for one reason: blake3 (content hashing), ignore (gitignore-aware walking), libc (sockets, passing descriptors, getpeereid, launchd activation), memchr (newline and substring scans), regex (search; std has none), serde_json (MCP messages), tree-sitter and its C, C#, JavaScript, Python, Rust and TypeScript grammars (outlines and read --symbol) and Dart grammar (the terse view; Python and TypeScript serve it too), and ureq with rustls and the platform verifier, without default features (the HTTP side of the MCP proxy, blocking like the rest of the daemon, with the operating system's trust store). Cargo.toml states the reason beside each.
entities.rationale: Cargo.toml: "Each dependency has one reason; std covers everything else." blake3 is fast enough to hash every file lazily; memchr and blake3 use NEON on Apple Silicon; ureq keeps the proxy synchronous, so no async runtime is pulled in.
